bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
target=fb2f26a6a9a7811213891f715ad6c225b5a6f00a
base=d6d490c68b3e44790a90f13b727d425815b865e1
checkout="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
release="$root/.releases/$target/preview-montage-v1"
test -d "$release" || exit 80
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(cat "$release/base-image")" || exit 81
files="src/sales/sampleMedia.mjs src/sales/autoPreview.mjs src/telegram/mediaProcessor.mjs src/telegram/freeAlbum.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/sales/pgListings.mjs src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs"
for f in $files;do
 for d in live base new patch;do mkdir -p "$release/$d/$(dirname "$f")";done
 docker cp "$cid:/opt/videobot/$f" "$release/live/$f"
 git -C "$checkout" show "$base:$f" > "$release/base/$f"
 git -C "$checkout" show "$target:$f" > "$release/new/$f"
 if ! git merge-file -p --diff3 "$release/live/$f" "$release/base/$f" "$release/new/$f" > "$release/patch/$f";then
   printf '\n=== CONFLICT %s ===\n' "$f"
   python3 - "$release/patch/$f" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
s=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().splitlines()
on=False
for l in s:
    if l.startswith('<<<<<<< '):on=True
    if on:print(l)
    if l.startswith('>>>>>>> '):on=False
PY
 fi
done
echo MONTAGE_CONFLICT_INSPECTION_COMPLETE
